name: MCA-Bench
description: As automated attack techniques rapidly advance, CAPTCHAs remain a critical defense mechanism against malicious bots. However, existing CAPTCHA schemes encompass a diverse range of modalities—from static distorted text and obfuscated images to interactive clicks, sliding puzzles, and logic-based questions—yet the community still lacks a unified, large-scale, multimodal benchmark to rigorously evaluate their security robustness.
